title: Generate the account-linking config in the skill manifest and deploy it via ASK CLI
description: The generator adds accountLinkingRequest (AUTH_CODE, authorizationUrl, accessTokenUrl, clientId, scopes, PKCE, domains) to the deploy. The client secret goes through `ask smapi update-account-linking-info` in CI. Linking is optional.
